look_first: For project Hydrocotyle, start with creeping node-rooting stems and centrally peltate leaves, then inflorescence architecture and flattened ribbed fruit.

confusable.tie_breaker: This is partly a circumscription trap: older floras often placed Hydrocotyle in Apiaceae. Current project taxonomy follows Araliaceae. Recognize the Hydrocotyle morphology package first, then apply current family placement.

exceptions: Do not teach Araliaceae as woody-only; the project representatives are creeping wetland herbs.
visuals: H. umbellata simple or proliferous umbel vs H. verticillata stacked verticils
